title: envelope
description: Common fields every claim document gets, regardless of group. Fields marked x-source=pipeline are filled in by code; the rest are extracted from the document.

claim_id.description: Claim the document belongs to (from the source folder / system).

document_id.description: Stable ID of the source document.

source_path.description: Where the original file lives (file share path, blob URL, Documentum ID).

document_group.description: Group assigned by the classifier step.

document_type.description: Most specific type of this document.

document_date.description: Main date of the document (sent, issued, or report date), as YYYY-MM-DD.

summary.description: Two to four sentence summary of what the document says about the claim.

key_entities.description: People, organizations, vehicles, properties, and addresses named in the document.

full_text_markdown.description: Full document text as Markdown (from Doc Intel or Content Understanding).

confidence.description: Classifier confidence for document_group (0-1). Self-reported by the model on the Doc Intel path, so treat it as a rough signal.
